description: Header file defining sensor enumeration, configurations, external variables, and function prototypes for Bosch sensor hardware control in Android HAL.

methods.name: hwcntl_main
methods.description: Main hardware control thread or function for sensor management.

methods.name: hwcntl_init
methods.description: Initializes hardware control with a BoschSensor object.

methods.name: get_sensor_t
methods.description: Retrieves sensor_t structure and index for a given sensor ID.

methods.name: activate_configref_resort
methods.description: Enables or disables a sensor configuration reference based on index.

methods.name: batch_configref_resort
methods.description: Configures batch parameters for a sensor based on index.

methods.name: convert_BSX_ListInx
methods.description: Converts a sensor list index to a different representation.
